_why: THE RELEASE BUILD'S CRASH AND STALL CHECK. The user, 2026-10-29, after the 1935 save loaded into the release build: "Go on with observer n=1 on the release build. I understand that it will lack telemetry, we just want to understant it doesn't crash or stall (I'll check stalling myself)." One observer century on the 1.0 PLAYER build (build.ps1 -Release: no telemetry, logging stripped but the init manifest line, no Recipe BE, no build stamp), through the new `kind: release` setup (run_observer -NoTelemetry). Not a measurement: no markets.tsv, no register reading from telemetry; the yearly save summaries, the tick lines (wall clock, the L41 freeze watch), the crash resumes and the run's own error window are what it yields.

No error line names a zzz_pm_rehaul file. Play time within ~10% of the debug canon's ~165-195 min, a little faster if anything (no telemetry dumps, no debug_log lines). Magnitude of the speed-up not argued.
